label: early original-phase steps just after an h (or after digit 2/3)
explanation: Fires almost entirely during the original (input) phase at early positions t=1..5 (peak t=2), plus the <DEL> step in short sequences; essentially silent in the copy phase and never at t=0. The dominant driver is the letter h one or two steps back: prev_tok==h has 10.6x lift and 54% of activation mass, prev2_tok==h 8x. Activation is largest the step right after h, decays at the following step, and is largest when h appears early (sequences beginning with h, e.g. h h n gives the max). A weaker secondary trigger is the digits 2 or 3 as the previous token at early positions (~5x lift). h late in the sequence (t>=6) produces little or nothing. A diffuse low-magnitude background (bottom two quartiles) at early original positions with no h/2/3 is not captured. Dev: P 0.69, R 0.74, mass recall 0.88.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: h, 2, 3, u, b, l; least: s, w, a, t) and the input two steps back (most: h, 3, 2, r, 1, b; least: q, w, t, a); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=1, t=4.
